args: const r=await fetch('https://sd2.youdooart.com/api/release',{cache:'no-store'}); const data=await r.json();if(r.status!==200||data.version!=='0.43.3'||r.headers.get('x-sd2-origin')!=='server-42-193')throw Error('Live baseline mismatch');console.log(JSON.stringify({status:r.status,origin:r.headers.get('x-sd2-origin'),release:data,checkedAt:new Date().toISOString()}));
